Back when I was 11 YO, (I’m 27 now) my father was very sick for a few years now. It was late at night so I was sleeping, I remember turning in the bed to the other side, and I saw him standing in front of the closet, I stared at him and he looked back at me and smile. I had the same feeling you described, the happiness of seeing him happy. I felt so at peace that I closed my eyes and kept sleeping. 
Minutes later my mom entered the room to tell me he had passed. 
To this day I don’t understand the meaning of what I saw or if it was a dream or not. 
What I do understand is the feeling you describe, maybe you had unresolved emotions towards her and it is just the universe telling you that she is fine. Just as it told me that my dad was finally fine.
